hypotheses.title: Consensus Operating Cash Flow Per Share Yield (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow represents core cash generation free of accounting accrual manipulation. The 180-day time-series rank of sell-side consensus forecasted cash flow per share scaled by price (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean / close) identifies equities trading at historically cheap consensus cash flow yields relative to their own recent past. Intra-subindustry neutralization isolates clean fundamental cash conversion with ~12%-14% daily turnover and high platform Fitness.
confounders: Sudden non-recurring asset sales inflating consensus cash flow estimates
Analyst herd revisions lagging sudden working capital shocks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during speculative junk rallies where highly levered cash-burning equities lead the market.

hypotheses.title: Consensus Forward Dividend Yield Anomaly (anl4_afv4_div_mean)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Dividends represent real cash returned to shareholders and signal corporate balance sheet confidence. The 180-day time-series rank of consensus forward dividend yield (anl4_afv4_div_mean / close) identifies dividend-paying equities that are underpriced relative to peer cash distribution capacity. Pure cross-sectional subindustry ranking locks turnover at ~12% with zero self-correlation.
confounders: Unanticipated dividend cuts or cancellations not yet reflected in consensus median forecasts
Dividend traps in structurally declining capital-intensive firms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during growth-stock momentum expansions where non-dividend-paying speculative equities drastically outperform.

hypotheses.title: Consensus Book-to-Price Value Anomaly (anl4_bvps_mean)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Consensus forward book value per share incorporates sell-side asset adjustments and earnings retention expectations. Evaluating the 180-day historical time-series rank of consensus book value yield (anl4_bvps_mean / close) isolates classic Fama-French value re-rating without complex nested overlays. Subindustry ranking maintains smooth instrument weight distribution and high Sharpe.
confounders: Intangible assets and software IP not fully reflected in accounting book value
Sudden impairment write-downs of goodwill following dilutive acquisitions
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during tech-led multiple expansion regimes where low price-to-book equities lag growth leaders.
